groups.why: This row saves specific conditions (Div 81, End Customer) with F6 and checks they come back in a new tab, which is a different expectation from the Period-exclusion and ALL-restore rows.
It says Period must not be in the saved condition, while V-afa7c7b2 says a Period key in the saved data is not a defect, so one result (a Period key is present) would fail this row and pass that one.
Under this confirmed rule, a Period key in the saved data is not a defect and Period is not compared on restore, so its pass/fail can differ from the general row V-52b9bb21.
This row tests a different button (Reset Condition F10), expecting only the server-saved condition to be deleted while the on-screen values stay.

This row checks that the Active=ALL condition is restored after reconnecting, a different condition and state from the other rows, and it is unconfirmed whether SSP0005 has an Active field, so it stays on its own.
This screen rule bundles three expectations (new-tab restore matches, Period not saved, ALL restored), so it is not the same as any single row and is measured on its own.
